Our innovative cover was designed to specifically fit your Kindle Paperwhite and secures your device without any hinges or straps. Thin, lightweight, and durable, this cover is perfect for taking Kindle Paperwhite wherever you go. The Fintie SlimShell Case comes in a variety of bright, fun colors, the widest selections to suite your taste. Available in a variety of bright and fun colors.
